info.title: Kokoro IAM Internal API
info.description: IAM-owned liveness, Tenancy, Authorization and Audit operations.

platformExecutionServiceBearer.description: Receiver-owned kokoro-platform/execution_authorization credential bound to one tenant; no OAuth token or introspection.

billingServiceBearer.description: Receiver-owned direct service credential, bound to kokoro-billing, billing_authorization and one tenant; no OAuth token or introspection.

bffUserContextServiceBearer.description: Receiver-owned kokoro-bff/bff_user_context credential bound to one tenant. Requires one x-kokoro-actor-id; no Cookie or user OAuth token.

accountSessionServiceBearer.description: Independent kokoro-bff/account_sessions receiver credential. Requires native issuer Cookie AND exact IAM_WEB_ORIGIN.

accountSessionIssuerCookie.name: kokoro-issuer.session_token
accountSessionIssuerCookie.description: Allowlisted issuer Cookie; production uses __Secure- prefix. Exact Origin and fresh Session/User/active tenant/member required.

skillListBearer.description: Only Skills-list identity/profile operations accept user API Keys or registered App OAuth.
